camel_example: aliyun iot ModifyOTAFirmware --region cn-hangzhou --FirmwareId s8SSHiKjpBfrM3BSN0z8030000 --ProductKey a1uctKe0000
description_en: Modifies the information of an OTA update package, including the package name, description, and custom information
description_zh: 调用该接口修改升级包信息，包括升级包名称、升级包描述和自定义信息
kebab_example: aliyun iot modify-ota-firmware --product-key a1uctKe0000 --firmware-id s8SSHiKjpBfrM3BSN0z8030000 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyOTAFirmware

parameters.help_en: The ProductKey of the product to which the over-the-air update upgrade package belongs
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the over-the-air update upgrade package. The ID is the unique identity of the over-the-air update upgrade package.

The over-the-air update upgrade package ID is one of the parameters returned when you invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147311.html operation to create an over-the-air update upgrade package.

You can also invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147450.html operation to view the ID in the response
parameters.help_zh:
OTA升级包ID，OTA升级包的唯一标识符。

OTA升级包ID是调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147311.html创建OTA升级包时，返回的参数之一。

您也可以调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147450.html，从返回参数中查看
parameters.name: firmware_id

parameters.help_en: The description of the over-the-air update upgrade package. The description can be up to 100 characters in length. Each Chinese character counts as one character
parameters.help_zh: OTA升级包描述。长度不可超过100个字符。一个中文汉字算一个字符
parameters.name: firmware_desc

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If this ID value is available, you must specify it. Otherwise, the call fails.
If no Overview page or ID value is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无实例概览页面或ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the over-the-air update upgrade package. The name must be unique within the Alibaba Cloud account. The name can contain Chinese characters, letters, Japanese characters, digits, hyphens (-), underscores (_), and parentheses (()). The name must start with a Chinese character, letter, Japanese character, or digit. The name must be 1 to 40 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: OTA升级包名称，需在阿里云账号下唯一。支持中文、英文字母、日文、数字、短划线（-）、下划线（_）和半角圆括号（()），必须以中文、英文、日文或数字开头，长度限制为1~40个字符
parameters.name: firmware_name

parameters.example: {"ota_notice":"升级底层摄像头驱动，解决视频图像模糊的问题。"}
parameters.help_en: The custom information to be pushed to the device. The text content format is not limited. The information can be up to 4,096 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 推送给设备的自定义信息。不限制文本内容格式，长度不超过4096个字符
parameters.name: firmware_udi
